visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation sequence opens on a deep purple backdrop. A large, glowing yellow full moon occupies the upper-middle frame, flanked by two floating red lanterns with gold tassels. Soft, stylized white cartoon clouds wrap around the moon's edges. Large, bold yellow Chinese characters '月滿中秋' are placed directly over the center of the lunar disk, setting a festive digital stage. (2) A stylized 3D animated male character with a short fade haircut and black sunglasses slides rapidly into the frame from the bottom. He is wearing a bright green blazer over a dark shirt, accessorized with a prominent gold chain and a Bitcoin symbol pendant. He holds a golden-brown, patterned mooncake in his right hand and brings it to his face to take a simulated bite. (3) After the bite, the character lowers his hand and looks toward the camera. He brings both hands together to form a clear heart shape in front of his chest. Simultaneously, white outlines of rabbits appear in the background clouds, and delicate pink clouds drift across the screen. The scene maintains a clean, high-saturation 3D animation style throughout the entire duration.

This is immediately joined by a bright, high-tempo electronic background track featuring a driving 128 BPM beat, sharp snare hits, and a shimmering synthesizer melody that establishes a modern, high-energy festive atmosphere. (2) A crisp, percussive crunch sound effect is triggered with high spectral intensity and rapid decay, simulating the sound of a bite. The background music maintains its rhythmic density, with the kick drum providing a strong low-end foundation while digital high-hats add a consistent rhythmic texture. The sound design is clean and emphasizes high-frequency clarity. (3) A resonant, tonal 'pop' or 'ding' sound effect with a clear harmonic tail and a slight digital delay marks the conclusion of the gesture. The background music continues its upbeat loop, exhibiting high spectral dynamism and a polished, compressed mastering style. There is zero background noise, reflecting a professional studio production quality throughout the clip.

The video combines crypto-culture aesthetics (the Bitcoin chain) with traditional holiday symbols (moon, mooncake, rabbits) to create a modern, high-energy celebratory message aimed at a younger, tech-savvy audience.
